services.name: martial arts
services.desc: Hong Ik Martial Arts of New Rochelle led the Taekwondo program for the 2026 Challenge Camp hosted at Iona University. Challenge Camp is ACA accredited and this year marked its 46th Summer of Fun and Learning. The main instructors for the 2 sessions from early June until mid-August, were Master Shinmin, MyungSa Jonathan, and MyungSa Ryan, assisted by Susa Musa Korin and Susa Alina. This year’s Celebration Day, held on August 2nd, invited the Taekwondo campers to the Dojang to display what they practiced at Iona University to earn their next rank.
